_meta.purpose: 海外网站上的洋网红/外籍创作者讲中国故事素材（非国内上海洋网红报道）
_meta.scope: 优先 .com/.co.uk 等海外域名图文页：个人站、英美澳媒体对外国创作者的访谈
_meta.pack_desc: 海外网站洋网红 / 外籍创作者图文

items.theme: Food Ranger shows Chinese street food to Western YouTube
items.creator: Trevor James / The Food Ranger
items.title: Inside the world of one of YouTube's most popular food vloggers
items.quote_en: Today, the Food Ranger is one of the most popular food vloggers in the world. His specialty is China and the country's ancient street food culture that hides out in curbside shops all over the 26 provinces... In a country that's misunderstood by those outside of its borders, that outsider status is crucial to his appeal.
items.quote_cn: Vox：加拿大籍 YouTuber Food Ranger（Trevor James）以中国街头美食闻名全球，向海外观众展示各省街头饮食文化。
items.statement_for_kb: Canadian YouTuber Trevor James (The Food Ranger), profiled by Vox, specializes in documenting Chinese street-food culture across many provinces for a primarily Western YouTube audience.

items.creator: Trevor James / The Food Ranger
items.title: Inside the world of one of YouTube's most popular food vloggers
items.quote_en: I try to show them my excitement for the food, and how cool what they're creating is, and how cool China is in general... It's everyday for them, but here's a foreigner who thinks it's the coolest thing in the world... We like to stay away from any politics whatsoever... We do food and positivity.
items.quote_cn: James：用兴奋感让摊主感到自己做的东西很酷、中国很酷；内容坚持食物与正面叙事，刻意远离政治。
items.statement_for_kb: Food Ranger tells Vox he uses Mandarin and visible enthusiasm to open vendors up, aiming to show how cool Chinese food and China can be through non-political, positive food storytelling.

items.theme: Personal site: moved to Chengdu for food adventure
items.creator: Trevor James
items.title: About - The Food Ranger
items.quote_en: I moved to Chengdu for one reason: the food... There was this magical feeling on the streets that I couldn't get enough of... I've decided that apart from traveling and eating, I also want to inspire people and put some positivity out there in the world, showing people that the world is truly a beautiful place, full of friendly people and that it's not as scary as a lot of the media makes it out to be.
items.quote_cn: Food Ranger 个人站：因美食移居成都；希望通过旅行美食内容展示世界友好，而不像部分媒体渲染得那么可怕。
items.statement_for_kb: On his overseas personal site, Trevor James says he moved to Chengdu for the food and aims to show through travel/food videos that the world is full of friendly people, countering fear-driven media narratives.

items.theme: SCMP on Food Ranger street-food enthusiasm
items.creator: Trevor James / The Food Ranger
items.title: Malaysia's top YouTube food star is a Canadian – Trevor James, aka The Food Ranger
items.quote_en: Trevor James' extreme enthusiasm for seeking out delicious street food in obscure places across Asia chimes with his 4.6 million subscribers... It's amazing that we get to do what we do, and I've always found excitement in travelling all over the world.
items.quote_cn: 南华早报（海外英文站）：加拿大创作者 Food Ranger 以寻访亚洲偏僻街头美食著称，拥有数百万订阅。
items.statement_for_kb: SCMP profiles Canadian creator Trevor James (The Food Ranger) for enthusiastic street-food hunting across Asia, including China-related coverage, for a large YouTube audience.

items.theme: Strictly Dumpling started from Chinese cultural content
items.creator: Mike Chen / Strictly Dumpling
items.title: Mike Chen talks food, YouTube and traveling the world
items.quote_en: I started out doing Chinese traditional cultural content on YouTube [about six years ago on a channel called Off the Great Wall], so I wasn't always doing this. Then one day I thought, 'I really want to eat and have people watch me.'... Then it just worked out and I was able to make a living off of it.
items.quote_cn: 美国大学媒体 The Pitt News：华裔美籍 YouTuber Mike Chen（Strictly Dumpling）早期做中国传统文化内容，后转向美食旅行并以此为业。
items.statement_for_kb: US campus paper The Pitt News quotes YouTuber Mike Chen (Strictly Dumpling): he began with Chinese traditional cultural content on Off the Great Wall before building a food-travel career.

items.theme: Travel breaks stereotypes about the world
items.creator: Mike Chen
items.title: Mike Chen talks food, YouTube and traveling the world
items.quote_en: That was when I first realized I wanted to get out there and see the world because it's not at all what you hear about from other people.
items.quote_cn: Chen：亲身旅行后发现世界并不像别人转述的那样，想走出去亲眼看。
items.statement_for_kb: Mike Chen tells US students that firsthand travel showed him the world is not what secondhand stories suggest—an openness frame useful for culture storytelling.

items.theme: Blondie in China Australian creator on overseas AFR
items.creator: Amy Lyons / Blondie in China
items.title: Blondie in China: How this Australian made a living eating her way through China
items.quote_en: Amy Lyons, the 33-year-old star of Blondie in China, a food channel with more than one million followers across YouTube, TikTok, Bilibili and Xiaohongshu...
items.quote_cn: 澳大利亚金融评论报：澳籍创作者 Amy Lyons（Blondie in China）以吃遍中国为内容，海外与国内平台粉丝超百万。
items.statement_for_kb: Australian Financial Review profiles Australian creator Amy Lyons (Blondie in China), whose China food channel has over one million followers across YouTube and other platforms.

items.theme: Fuchsia Dunlop bridges Chinese cuisine for Westerners (CNN)
items.creator: Fuchsia Dunlop
items.title: Sichuan cuisine: More than just spice
items.quote_en: Do you see yourself as a bridge between Chinese and Western foodies? That's what I'm trying to do. I think Chinese cuisine is probably the most diverse and sophisticated in the world... And it's very underrated and not very deeply understood in the West.
items.quote_cn: CNN：英国美食作家 Fuchsia Dunlop 自视为中西美食爱好者之间的桥梁，认为中国菜极度丰富却在西方被低估、理解不深。
items.statement_for_kb: CNN interview: British food writer Fuchsia Dunlop, first Western trainee at Sichuan's cooking institute, aims to bridge Chinese and Western food cultures and argues Chinese cuisine is underrated in the West.

items.theme: Sichuan food more than hot and spicy
items.creator: Fuchsia Dunlop
items.title: Sichuan cuisine: More than just spice
items.quote_en: It's much more subtle than that... A good Sichuanese meal is not all hot; it's balanced. There's a saying: Yicaiyige baicaibaiwei, meaning, 'Each dish has its own style; a hundred dishes have a hundred different flavors.'
items.quote_cn: Dunlop：川菜远不止“麻辣”，好的川菜讲究平衡；一菜一格、百菜百味。
items.statement_for_kb: Fuchsia Dunlop explains on CNN that Sichuan cuisine is subtler than 'hot and spicy,' emphasizing balance and the ideal of a hundred dishes with a hundred flavors.

items.theme: Guardian: Dunlop matchmakes Westerners with Chinese food
items.creator: Fuchsia Dunlop
items.title: I eat to understand: cook and writer Fuchsia Dunlop on her lifelong love of Chinese cuisine
items.quote_en: Dunlop... loves nothing more than matchmaking Western eaters with what is to them unfamiliar and sometimes intimidating Chinese food. In 30 years of exploring and documenting the country, she has done for China what Elizabeth David did for Mediterranean food... When I go to China, people ask me, 'Why have you come to China?' And I say, 'I've come to eat.'
items.quote_cn: 卫报：Dunlop 30年来向西方介绍中国饮食，称去中国是“为了吃”，通过吃去理解。
items.statement_for_kb: The Guardian describes Fuchsia Dunlop as spending 30 years introducing Western audiences to Chinese food, saying she goes to China 'to eat' in order to understand.

items.theme: Washington Post traveler via Lost Plate hutong food
items.creator: Lost Plate (Brian Bergey & Ruixi Hu) / WaPo traveler narrative
items.title: Delving into the hutongs of Beijing, chopsticks at the ready
items.quote_en: My first visit to mainland China is a short one of just seven days, and I want to be able to come away feeling like I've tasted some real Chinese food, the stuff that the locals eat. Enter Lost Plate, a small tour company that dives straight into the dense alley neighborhoods (hutongs) of the old city and visits hole-in-the-wall restaurants that visitors generally can't find.
items.quote_cn: 华盛顿邮报：西方旅行者通过 Lost Plate 深入北京胡同，品尝本地人常去的小馆，而非游客菜单。
items.statement_for_kb: A Washington Post travel piece describes finding 'real' local Beijing food in hutong eateries via Lost Plate, contrasting tourist menus with what locals eat.

items.theme: Lost Plate overseas site: food reveals local stories
items.creator: Lost Plate Food Tours
items.title: Lost Plate Food Tours
items.quote_en: Food reveals things that the internet can't. Every dish has a story. It reflects local ingredients and preserves traditions that have been passed down for generations. A great food tour combines cuisine, culture, history, and neighborhood exploration into a single experience.
items.quote_cn: Lost Plate 官网：食物能揭示互联网看不到的东西；每道菜都有故事，连接食材、传统与街区生活。
items.statement_for_kb: Lost Plate's overseas website frames Chinese food tours as storytelling: each dish reflects local ingredients and generational traditions beyond what the internet shows.

items.theme: Chicago Maroon on Strictly Dumpling positive energy
items.creator: Mike Chen / Strictly Dumpling
items.title: Strictly Dumpling Talks Food, Fitness, and Identity
items.quote_en: With over 3 million subscribers on YouTube, Mike Chen is an established celebrity in YouTube's massive food community. Those who watch his videos know his greatest appeal lies in the positive energy he exudes no matter where he is or what food he is trying.
items.quote_cn: 芝加哥大学学生报：Strictly Dumpling 以正向能量与全球美食探索吸引数百万订阅。
items.statement_for_kb: University of Chicago's Chicago Maroon highlights Mike Chen (Strictly Dumpling) for positive-energy food travel content with millions of YouTube subscribers.

items.theme: Guardian on Jiangnan food ease and craft
items.creator: Fuchsia Dunlop
items.title: China's best-kept food secret, revealed by Fuchsia Dunlop
items.quote_en: While every Chinese cuisine has its charms... I know of no other that can put one's heart so much at ease as the food of Jiangnan.
items.quote_cn: 卫报引 Dunlop：江南菜能让人心安，是中国饮食中极具魅力的一脉。
items.statement_for_kb: In The Guardian, Fuchsia Dunlop writes that Jiangnan cuisine uniquely puts one's heart at ease among China's regional food cultures.
